Replace the side stacks with continuous compressed sidewalls bearing broad shallow concave finger-pad hollows. Each hollow should correspond in direction and width to the nearby withdrawn finger pads. Retain a few irregular compression creases at the hollow rims and widened bottom, without making four separate purple fingers or horizontal tubes. Show a clear thin yellow gap, approximately 0.8–1.2% of canvas width, between EVERY adjacent finger pad and the clay. All fingertips are just withdrawing outward from their matched hollows. Hands are coherent five-finger clay anatomy, with clearly attached fingers and palms; do not obscure central volume.

Keep the large dome that rises from the SAME squashed lower base and its connected silhouette. The base remains broad and flattened while upper-center surface rounds upward, so pressure and recovery can be read within one object without arrows or a before/after object. Clay object stays large in central x20–80%, y23–61%. Preserve the bright purple/yellow contrast and strong non-glyph center.

It should read across the opening hands without overwhelming the mass. Keep clear counters, correct 초·중·종성 and ordinary word spacing. Preserve its centered hierarchy and the event/action grouping, followed by date/time, venue and application. All six strings must remain exact, complete, in raised clay and without any additional copy, symbols or logo.

The body remains matte opaque clay, with broad soft shading and a softly worked surface, not a polished plastic/balloon/liquid. Retain controlled soft cast shadows and consistent upper-left light on title, hands and information. Background clean yellow, no uniform grain, confetti, labels, arrows or motion decoration.
